articles.title: Zimbabwe crash involving church members kills 27
articles.description: A collision between a minibus taxi carrying church members and a haulage truck has killed 27 people in Zimbabwe. A police spokesperson said Saturday that the crash occurred near Chivhu town, south of the capital, Harare. The minibus taxi was traveling to a church conference Friday when it collided head-on with the truck. Local media report the minibus taxi burst into flames and was reduced to a shell. Police say both vehicles were carrying an “unspecified” number of passengers. Road accidents in Zimbabwe are common and often blamed on dangerous driving and poor road conditions. The country has one of the worst road safety records, with most accidents attributed to human error.
